extra_vocab.en: to exchange points, a coupon, or a voucher for a discount or a gift
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，redeem their reward points 是會員在櫃檯「用紅利點數兌換」折扣。促銷廣告和會員制度中很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用句型是 redeem + 點數／優惠券 + for + 贈品或折扣，或 redeem + 點數 + at + 地點。

example.en: Each customer who redeems a coupon receives a free gift.
example.zh: 每位兌換優惠券的顧客都會收到一份免費贈品。

example.en: All unused vouchers must be redeemed before the end of June.
example.zh: 所有未使用的禮券必須在六月底前兌換。

example.en: Customers redeeming points online will see the discount at checkout.
example.zh: 在線上兌換點數的顧客會在結帳時看到折扣。

example.en: You can redeem your points for a free coffee.
example.zh: 你可以用點數兌換一杯免費咖啡。

example.en: Please redeem your coupon before the end of the month.
example.zh: 請在月底前使用你的優惠券。

example.en: Guests may redeem the voucher at any of our hotels.
example.zh: 賓客可在我們任何一家飯店兌換這張禮券。

example.en: Customers can redeem ten stamps for a free meal.
example.zh: 顧客可以用十個點數換一份免費餐點。

examples.en: Members may redeem their rewards at the register.
examples.zh: 會員可以在櫃檯兌換他們的回饋。

examples.en: The code can only be redeemed once per customer.
examples.zh: 這組代碼每位顧客只能兌換一次。

confusable.diff: refund 是「退還現金」，redeem 是用點數或憑證「換取」折扣或商品。

example.en: We will refund the full amount within five business days.
example.zh: 我們會在五個工作天內全額退款。

similar.diff: exchange 是一般的「交換、換貨」；redeem 特指用點數、優惠券或憑證換取。

example.en: You may exchange the item within thirty days.
example.zh: 你可以在三十天內換貨。

similar.diff: cash in 較口語，強調把點數或憑證換成現金或好處。

example.en: Many members cash in their points at the end of the year.
example.zh: 許多會員在年底兌換他們的點數。

example.en: Show this coupon to get ten percent off.
example.zh: 出示這張優惠券就能享九折。

example.en: Each guest received a dinner voucher.
example.zh: 每位賓客都收到一張晚餐禮券。

example.en: Loyal customers earn rewards on every purchase.
example.zh: 忠實顧客每次購物都能累積回饋。

extra_vocab.en: to join two or more things together
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，cannot be combined with other offers 是促銷廣告常見的限制：這個折扣「不能與其他優惠合併使用」。這裡用被動語態。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: combine A with B 或 combine A and B 都可以；被動用 be combined with，表示「與…結合、合併使用」。

example.en: This package combines a laptop, a mouse, and a one-year warranty.
example.zh: 這個套裝組合包含一台筆電、一個滑鼠和一年保固。

example.en: The two departments combined their budgets to buy new equipment.
example.zh: 兩個部門合併了預算來購買新設備。

example.en: Combining the two reports saved us a lot of time.
example.zh: 把兩份報告合併起來為我們省下許多時間。

collocations.zh: 把 A 和 B 結合

example.en: The new plan combines low prices with fast delivery.
example.zh: 新方案結合了低價和快速送貨。

example.en: This coupon cannot be combined with any other discount.
example.zh: 這張優惠券不能與其他折扣合併使用。

example.en: The combined total of both orders is $3,200.
example.zh: 兩筆訂單合計是 3,200 美元。

example.en: The two firms combined forces to launch the product.
example.zh: 兩家公司聯手推出這項產品。

examples.en: We plan to combine the two departments next year.
examples.zh: 我們計畫明年合併這兩個部門。

examples.en: She combined a business trip with a short vacation.
examples.zh: 她把出差和一段短暫的假期結合在一起。

similar.diff: merge 多指公司、檔案或系統「合併成一個」；combine 是把幾個東西結合，不一定變成一個。

example.en: The two banks will merge in the spring.
example.zh: 這兩家銀行會在春天合併。

similar.diff: mix 較口語，指把東西混在一起，常用於材料或顏色。

example.en: Mix the two samples before you start the test.
example.zh: 開始測試前，先把兩個樣品混合。

example.en: The company merged with a larger competitor.
example.zh: 這家公司與一家較大的競爭對手合併了。

example.en: The bundle includes a laptop and a carrying case.
example.zh: 這個套裝包含一台筆電和一個攜帶包。

derived.link: combine + -ation，「結合」變名詞，像 organize → organization
combine + -d，「被結合的」，如 combined effort（共同努力）

extra_vocab.en: a person who works with you or has a job in a company
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，sales associate 是店內的「業務專員」，也就是零售業中負責接待客人的店員。廣告請顧客有問題可詢問任何一位專員。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 動詞 associate 是 associate A with B（把 A 和 B 聯想在一起），with 不能換成 to；常用被動 be associated with。

example.en: Store associates wear name badges so customers can find them easily.
example.zh: 店內專員會配戴名牌，方便顧客找到他們。

example.en: Delays are usually associated with poor communication between teams.
example.zh: 延誤通常與團隊之間溝通不良有關。

example.en: Many shoppers keep associating this brand with low prices.
example.zh: 許多購物者一直把這個品牌和低價聯想在一起。

example.en: A sales associate will help you choose a laptop.
example.zh: 一位銷售專員會協助你挑選筆電。

example.en: I met a business associate at the trade fair.
example.zh: 我在貿易展上見到一位生意夥伴。

example.en: Customers often associate our brand with quality.
example.zh: 顧客常把我們的品牌和品質聯想在一起。

example.en: Several risks are associated with this project.
example.zh: 這個專案有幾項相關風險。

examples.en: Please ask any sales associate for more information.
examples.zh: 想知道更多資訊，請詢問任何一位銷售專員。

examples.en: Our associates will contact you within two business days.
examples.zh: 我們的專員會在兩個工作天內與你聯絡。

confusable.diff: assistant 是「助理」，協助主管做事；associate 是同層級的「專員、夥伴」。

example.en: My assistant will schedule the meeting for Tuesday.
example.zh: 我的助理會把會議排在星期二。

similar.diff: colleague 指同一間公司、同事務的「同事」；associate 也可指生意往來的夥伴。

example.en: I discussed the plan with a colleague from finance.
example.zh: 我和財務部的一位同事討論了這個計畫。

similar.diff: representative 是「代表」，代表公司與客戶接觸；sales associate 較常用在零售店面。

example.en: A sales representative will visit your office next week.
example.zh: 一位業務代表下週會拜訪你的辦公室。

example.en: A colleague will cover my shift tomorrow.
example.zh: 明天會有一位同事代我的班。

example.en: A customer service representative answered my call.
example.zh: 一位客服代表接了我的電話。

derived.link: associate 去 e 加 -ion 變名詞，像 organize → organization

example.en: The store hired three new sales associates this month.
example.zh: 這家店這個月僱用了三位新的銷售專員。

example.en: People associate this brand with reliable service.
example.zh: 人們把這個品牌和可靠的服務聯想在一起。

example.en: She was promoted to associate director last year.
example.zh: 她去年升任副主任。

senses.en: an employee who helps customers in a store

example.en: Ask the associate at the counter about the discount.
example.zh: 請向櫃檯的專員詢問折扣。

senses.en: a person you work with in business
senses.distinguish: 和 business 連用（business associate）時，指生意往來的夥伴。

example.en: He introduced me to a business associate from Seoul.
example.zh: 他介紹我認識一位來自首爾的生意夥伴。
